access to electricity, transport infrastructure, and ICT have positive and statistically significant effect on inclusive growth in Nigeria.
access to electricity, transport infrastructure and ICT are significant in reducing poverty in Nigeria.

access to electricity has a negative impact on the incidence and depth of poverty in Nigeria, while transport infrastructure has a negative impact only on the depth of poverty, and ICT has a negative impact (although not statistically significant) only on the incidence of poverty.

the role of ICT access in reducing poverty and fostering inclusive growth.
the relationship between access to ICT, access to electricity and access to transport infrastructure and poverty reduction in Nigeria.
the role of ICT, access to electricity and access to transport infrastructure in reducing the incidence and depth of poverty and promoting inclusive economic growth in Nigeria.

access to electricity, transport infrastructure and ICT positively influence the incidence and depth of poverty reduction in Nigeria.
access to ICT has a significant positive effect on inclusive growth, but access to electricity and infrastructure has a negative effect.
ICT access is not a major driver of inclusive growth in Nigeria, while access to electricity and transportation infrastructure are major drivers of inclusive growth.

ICT has a positive impact on the incidence of poverty in Nigeria but not on the poverty gap and this has implications for inclusive growth.
access to electricity, ICT and transport infrastructure have positive and significant impact on inclusive growth.

access to electricity, ICT and transport infrastructure is important in promoting inclusive growth and reducing poverty in Nigeria.
